findings.owasp: A05:2021 Security Misconfiguration (CWE-1021 Improper Restriction of Rendered UI Layers)
findings.impact: CSP frame-ancestors directive ends with a bare `*` wildcard after three legitimate embedding origins (merchant.wolt.com, business.vivid.money, vivid://*). Per CSP 3 the trailing * matches any origin, making the directive permissive. Co-set x-frame-options: DENY is ignored by modern browsers when CSP frame-ancestors is present. Any attacker page can iframe mypos.finmid.com and clickjack an authenticated MyPOS merchant into in-session actions (likely to include payout bank-detail change, API key generation, user invite, financing offer approval). Severity is a floor at P2 Medium; promote toward P1 depending on which in-session actions are reachable, which needs an authenticated merchant to enumerate.

Second, parallel Metabase instance on the previously-undocumented staging environment (per F006) leaks setup-token 868359f8-6915-45e9-9ab3-fe5dfb3b81cc, same pre-auth-RCE pre-condition as F001. Also leaks version v0.54.14, plain-HTTP site-url http://metabase-external.ops.staging.finmid.io, analytics-uuid, Google SSO client ID, that password login is enabled with a 6-char/1-digit policy, and that initial setup is complete. Envoy whitelist currently blocks the exploit paths (verified today, same shape as F001).

findings.owasp: A05:2021 Security Misconfiguration (CWE-330 Use of Insufficiently Random Values)
findings.impact: The CSP header on the distributor admin SPA contains script-src source 'nonce-rAnd0m' - a literal placeholder string that never rotates, confirmed identical across four fetches spanning two hosts. The nonce is dead code today (no inline <script nonce='...'> uses it) but any future HTML-injection sink in the SPA (markdown render, SSR echo, third-party widget, Keycloak error redirect) becomes trivially bypassable: an attacker only has to add nonce='rAnd0m' to their injected <script> to turn CSP from a hard block into a no-op. Also co-flags the hygiene issue that platform.finmid.com frame-src still references the staging host https://analytics.finmid-staging.com/.

findings.owasp: A05:2021 Security Misconfiguration (CWE-200 Exposure of Sensitive Information)
findings.endpoint: HTTPS on platform / auth / analytics / api / gateway / platform.gateway / sandbox.gateway / webhooks / b2b-payments / short.bolt / maintenance .finmid-staging.com
findings.impact: An entire parallel staging environment on *.finmid-staging.com (not in subdomains.txt, discovered via a leftover reference in the production CSP frame-src) is reachable with no authentication on 10 of its 15 live hosts. The company clearly intended staging to be gated - 5 hosts (marketing root, www, apply, docs, zeos) sit behind a CloudFront-Function Basic Auth 401 - but the Basic Auth was never applied to platform, auth, analytics, api, gateway, platform.gateway, sandbox.gateway, webhooks, b2b-payments, short.bolt, maintenance. Impact: doubles the external attack surface for every shared component, delivers F004 (staging Metabase setup-token leak), delivers F005 on a second host, exposes the staging Keycloak realm config (ROPC enabled, HS* algs accepted), lets anyone fingerprint staging Capital API error semantics, and makes staging ROPC credential-stuffing cheaper than production (test accounts tend to have weaker passwords; not run per rules of engagement).
